inspiration.observed_pattern: FIRST_VALUE and LAST_VALUE with IGNORE NULLS fill telemetry gaps from the nearest non-null readings in both time directions within an ordered series.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a deterministic sensor-voltage report. Correlated scalar lookups select the nearest non-null reading at or before and at or after each sample using station, timestamp, and sample-ID ordering; COALESCE preserves an existing reading and fills only NULL gaps without copying the source schema or SQL Server syntax.

fixture_notes: Station 61 has two consecutive missing voltage readings between known values; station 62 starts with a missing reading and fills from its later observation. Existing readings remain unchanged, while each gap receives the nearest directional value.
determinism_notes: Station IDs, sample IDs, integer timestamps, fixed decimal readings, NULL gaps, lookup bounds, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE sensor_voltage_samples (sample_id INT PRIMARY KEY, station_id INT NOT NULL, sample_time INT NOT NULL, voltage DECIMAL(6,2) NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT s.sample_id, s.station_id, s.sample_time, s.voltage, (SELECT prior.voltage FROM sensor_voltage_samples AS prior WHERE prior.station_id = s.station_id AND prior.sample_time <= s.sample_time AND prior.voltage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY prior.sample_time DESC, prior.sample_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS previous_voltage, (SELECT future.voltage FROM sensor_voltage_samples AS future WHERE future.station_id = s.station_id AND future.sample_time >= s.sample_time AND future.voltage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY future.sample_time ASC, future.sample_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS next_voltage, COALESCE(s.voltage, (SELECT future.voltage FROM sensor_voltage_samples AS future WHERE future.station_id = s.station_id AND future.sample_time >= s.sample_time AND future.voltage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY future.sample_time ASC, future.sample_id ASC LIMIT 1), (SELECT prior.voltage FROM sensor_voltage_samples AS prior WHERE prior.station_id = s.station_id AND prior.sample_time <= s.sample_time AND prior.voltage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY prior.sample_time DESC, prior.sample_id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS filled_voltage FROM sensor_voltage_samples AS s ORDER BY s.station_id, s.sample_time, s.sample_id

checks.sql: SELECT sample_id, station_id, sample_time, voltage FROM sensor_voltage_samples ORDER BY station_id, sample_time, sample_id
